items.statement: After the alert system was introduced, the proportion of next airway managements in which known difficulty was documented as recognised beforehand rose by at least 20 percentage points above the pre-existing trend.
items.rationale: Recognition is the mechanism the system targets; the database and records allow a segmented series.

items.statement: Unanticipated difficulty at the next airway management fell after the alert system was introduced.
items.rationale: The patient-relevant consequence; fewer events limit precision.
